title: Netherite SMP
description: Netherite SMP is a semi anarchy server with vanilla feels, with custom world generation like the Farlands and Great Sea with friendly community!
body: Netherite SMP is a semi anarchy server with various mods that does not impact the game in a significant way. These mods are such as Farlands or The Great Sea and etc. We based on Singapore region so Asian Players can get low ping and low latency and feel and play the game smoothly.
